test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Ram, Shyam, Pankaj, Tilak and Gaurav are sitting in a straight line facing south. Tilak and Gaurav are sitting at the ends, Ram is sitting to the immediate left of Gaurav and to the immediate right of Pankaj. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Tilak?
solution:
Ram, Shyam, Pankaj, Tilak and Gaurav are sitting in a straight line facing south.

1) Tilak and Gaurav are sitting at the ends

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12272cf57fca2c50d15a267c5c2e4f1890649960365f3e455c2bccc8c3c78a69.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1749ade39d66570c4c336bdc05d9eb1bf0952f87ef72e5d268231eb3190cb7ff.png] 

2) Ram is sitting to the immediate left of Gaurav and to the immediate right of Pankaj.

Case (ii) is not considered.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ec4f7a677ad7ad360a429e7277fd2e3cf795f696eab4c33f2a7dbe96d49d262.png] 

∴ Here, 'Shyam' is sitting to the immediate right of Tilak.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shyam".**
